method: One adjacent fresh process per version, identical Python/Qt, offscreen, 140 cached navigations; no other active test process during these two measurements.

before.limitations: Linux source measurement, not Windows EXE/native CAD performance or a heap leak proof.

after.limitations: Linux source measurement, not Windows EXE/native CAD performance or a heap leak proof.

interpretation: Navigation median +0.58 ms and peak RSS +3936 KiB with the new workbench/inspector; widget count does not grow across navigation. Single-run measurements are not a statistical equivalence claim or Windows EXE benchmark.
